info.name: mawa core Launcher & Gateway
info.description: OpenAPI-style import for the two HTTP services shipped with the mawa core launcher image. The `picoclaw-launcher` binary (default port 18800) proxies browser traffic to a managed `picoclaw gateway` subprocess (default port 18790). All launcher endpoints except the public auth + static assets require a session cookie set by POST /api/auth/login. The gateway exposes /health, /ready, /reload (bearer-token), and channel-specific webhook mounts (LINE, Pico). See docs/reference/launcher-api.md for the full reference.

item.name: Launcher API (port 18800)
item.description: picoclaw-launcher web dashboard + API. Cookies/session required for every endpoint except the items in the "Public" subfolder.

item.name: Auth (public)
item.description: No session cookie required. POST /api/auth/login sets the `picoclaw_launcher_auth` HttpOnly cookie automatically when status=200.

request.description: Returns `{"authenticated":bool,"initialized":bool}`. Use this to decide whether to render login or setup page.
Body `{"password":"…"}`. Returns 200 `{"status":"ok"}` and sets the `picoclaw_launcher_auth` HttpOnly cookie. Also rate-limited per source IP.
Empty JSON body. Clears the session cookie.
First-run password creation. After init, requires an existing session (change-password flow). Cross-site requests blocked (matching Origin/Referer required).
Returns `{version,git_commit,build_time,go_version}` resolved from `picoclaw --version` if available, else launcher ldflags.
Returns `{port,public,allowed_cidrs,allow_localhost_bypass,trusted_proxy_cidrs}`.
Round-trips the launcher's persistent settings.
Returns `{enabled,supported,platform,message}`.
Shells out to the bundled updater to replace the launcher binary in place. Restart required after success.
Returns the full `config.Config` JSON (gateway token masked in lists, secrets omitted).
Full replacement. Validates against `validateConfig`. Returns 400 `validation_error` with `errors` list on failure. Secret fields are preserved via `SecurityCopyFrom` + `applyConfigSecretsFromMap`.
Partial update via JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396). Only fields present in the body are updated.
Preserves API keys/secrets. Restarts the gateway if it was running.
Returns `{allowed,blocked,matched_whitelist?,matched_blacklist?}`.
Returns `{models,total,default_model,provider_options}`. Each model has masked `api_key` (e.g. `sk-****abcd`).
Probes `/v1/models` (or `/api/tags` for Ollama, `/model/list` for `nearai`). Auto-saves to the per-provider catalog.
Appends a new model entry. Returns `{status,index}`.
Preserves existing `api_key` when omitted. Send `{}` for `extra_body` or `custom_headers` to clear them.
Clears `agents.defaults.model_name` if it was the default.
Fixed catalog: weixin, telegram, discord, slack, feishu, dingtalk, line, qq, onebot, wecom, whatsapp (bridge), whatsapp_native (native), pico, maixcam, matrix, irc, mqtt.
Returns `{config,configured_secrets,config_key,variant?}`. Secrets are stripped from `config`; only presence is reported in `configured_secrets`.
Reads from `~/.picoclaw/sessions/` and legacy Pico session JSON/JSONL files.
Returns `{id,title,created,updated,messages[]}`.
Returns the skill metadata plus its full `content`.
Requires `tools.find_skills` enabled (400 otherwise). `limit` 1..50, `offset` >= 0.
Requires `tools.install_skill` enabled.
Upload a workspace skill bundle (≤ 1 MiB).
Returns `{tools:[{name,description,category,config_key,status,reason_code?}]}`. status ∈ enabled|disabled|blocked.
Enable/disable a tool by name. `name` matches the `name` field from /api/tools (e.g. web_search, cron, exec, mcp_discovery).
Returns `{providers:[{provider,display_name,methods[],status,logged_in,...}]}`. `status` ∈ not_logged_in|connected|needs_refresh|expired.
Returns `{flow_id,user_code,verify_url,interval,expires_at}`. Poll /api/oauth/flows/{id} until status is connected|expired|error.
Returns `{flow_id}` plus the authorize URL bits. Browser redirects to the IdP and then hits /oauth/callback.
For browser flows: exchanges the auth code here on callback.
Browser redirect target for the `browser` flow. Completes the flow and redirects.
Returns `{flow_id,status:"wait",qr_data_uri}` (data-URI PNG). TTL 5 min.
status ∈ wait|scaned|confirmed|expired|error. On `confirmed`, the bot token + `ilink_bot_id` are saved into `channels.weixin` and the gateway is restarted if it was running.
Returns `{flow_id,status:"wait",qr_data_uri}` (data-URI PNG). TTL 5 min.
status ∈ wait|scaned|confirmed|expired|error. On `confirmed`, the `bot_id` + `secret` are saved into `channels.wecom` and the gateway is restarted if it was running.
Returns `{gateway_status,pid?,gateway_version?,boot_default_model?,config_default_model?,gateway_restart_required,gateway_start_allowed,gateway_start_reason?}`.
Ring buffer (200 lines) of stdout+stderr captured by the launcher. Pass back the previous `log_total`/`log_run_id` for incremental reads.
Returns 400 `precondition_failed` if no usable default model or credentials.
SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 3 s.
Returns `{ws_url,enabled,configured}`. No secrets.
Idempotent: enables the Pico channel and generates a token if none exists.
Rotates the WebSocket token in-place.
WebSocket upgrade. The launcher injects the raw Pico token via `Sec-Websocket-Protocol: token.<pico-token>` on the upstream request. 401 when no session cookie.
Proxied to the gateway with `Authorization: Bearer <pico-token>` injected. 503 when gateway is down, 403 when token is missing.

item.name: Gateway API (port 18790)
item.description: picoclaw gateway runtime. The shared HTTP server is created by the channel manager and binds to `gateway.host:gateway.port` (default 127.0.0.1:18790). Bearer token for /reload comes from `~/.picoclaw/picoclaw.pid.json` (`token` field), generated at startup.

request.description: Liveness probe. Returns `{status:"ok",uptime,pid,checks}` with 5 s timeouts. Used by `Dockerfile.launcher` HEALTHCHECK.
Readiness probe. 200 once `HealthServer.SetReady(true)` is flipped after services are up; 503 otherwise.
Returns `{status:"reload triggered"}` / 401 unauthorized / 405 method not allowed / 500 / 503 `reload not configured`. Refuses if the pidfile token is set and the bearer is missing/wrong.

item.name: Channel webhook receivers
item.description: Only channels that implement `WebhookHandler` register routes on the shared gateway mux. Currently: LINE (HTTP webhook) and Pico (WebSocket + media).

request.description: LINE Messaging API webhook. HMAC signature validated via line-bot-sdk-go. Body limit 1 MiB (oversize → 413, invalid signature → 403, parse errors → 400). On success returns 200 immediately and processes events in goroutines. Mount path is configurable via `channels.line.webhook_path`.
Pico channel WebSocket. Authenticated via `Sec-Websocket-Protocol: token.<pico-token>`.

header.description: Bearer pico token (managed by the launcher; clients read it via /api/pico/info)

request.description: Cached media downloads. 404 for unknown IDs.
